meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手持续跟踪长期目标，可随时查看和调整进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望让AI助手记住并持续推进你的长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your assistant on track with long-term goals, pause or resume anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to remember and keep working on multi-step goals.

howto.what: 装上后,它能将你要长期推进的事设为正式目标,记录内容与预算;你会随时查询进度。你宣告完成时,它会先核实实际成果,确认满足所有条件后才标记完成。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求对一个长期目标执行设置、暂停或完成等操作,或已有进行中的目标时。

say.text: 帮我设一个长期目标:完成一个家庭记账小应用。
say.note: Claude 会新建一条目标记录供后续跟踪。

say.text: 现在这个目标完成到什么程度了?
say.note: Claude 会查询并显示当前目标状态。

say.text: 这个目标我已全部搞定,请把它标记为完成。
say.note: 它会先核对实际交付,核对通过才会标记完成。

howto.what_en: Claude can persist a long-running goal, show its current status, and mark it complete. It only completes after verifying real evidence for each requirement; otherwise it stays incomplete.
howto.when_en: When the user explicitly asks to set, pause, or complete a long-running goal, or when an active goal already exists.

say_en.text: Set a long-term goal for me: build a small home budgeting app.
say_en.note: Claude will create a new goal record to track.

say_en.text: How far along is this goal now?
say_en.note: Claude will query and display the current goal status.

say_en.text: This goal is fully done; please mark it complete.
say_en.note: It completes only after checking actual deliverables.
